## Objective

Install the verified source into the two authorized project-local destinations and prove independent project preservation.

## Scope

- Fresh destination baselines
- Root adoption
- Template adoption
- Independent validation and protected-copy checks

## Entry conditions

- PHASE-006 source verification is complete and destination digests are current.

## Exit criteria

- Root and template exactly match verified maintained source files and pass independently.
- Memory Service and Electronics copies remain byte-identical to their pre-work baselines.

## Risks

- Dirty project-local files could be overwritten.
- A broad copy could cross the exact destination boundary.
